* Interface for an X.509 Attribute Certificate.
 * @deprecated use X509CertificateHolder class in the PKIX package.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public int getVersion()
methods.comment:
* Return the version number for the certificate.
     * 
     * @return the version number.

methods.name: public BigInteger getSerialNumber()
methods.comment:
* Return the serial number for the certificate.
     * 
     * @return the serial number.

methods.name: public Date getNotBefore()
methods.comment:
* Return the date before which the certificate is not valid.
     * 
     * @return the "not valid before" date.

methods.name: public Date getNotAfter()
methods.comment:
* Return the date after which the certificate is not valid.
     * 
     * @return the "not valid afer" date.

methods.name: public AttributeCertificateHolder getHolder()
methods.comment:
* Return the holder of the certificate.
     * 
     * @return the holder.

methods.name: public AttributeCertificateIssuer getIssuer()
methods.comment:
* Return the issuer details for the certificate.
     * 
     * @return the issuer details.

methods.name: public X509Attribute[] getAttributes()
methods.comment:
* Return the attributes contained in the attribute block in the certificate.
     * 
     * @return an array of attributes.

methods.name: public X509Attribute[] getAttributes(String oid)
methods.comment:
* Return the attributes with the same type as the passed in oid.
     * 
     * @param oid the object identifier we wish to match.
     * @return an array of matched attributes, null if there is no match.

methods.name: public void checkValidity() throws CertificateExpiredException, CertificateNotYetValidException
public void checkValidity(Date date) throws CertificateExpiredException, CertificateNotYetValidException
public void verify(PublicKey key, String provider) throws CertificateException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, InvalidKeyException, NoSuchProviderException, SignatureException
public byte[] getEncoded() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Return an ASN.1 encoded byte array representing the attribute certificate.
     * 
     * @return an ASN.1 encoded byte array.
     * @throws IOException if the certificate cannot be encoded.
